# PowerSearch { #anylumino.astryx.PowerSearch }

```python
PowerSearch(
    config,
    filters=(),
    *,
    label='',
    placeholder=None,
    disabled=False,
    read_only=None,
    clear=None,
    label_hidden=None,
    menu_width=None,
    **props,
)
```

Build structured filters with the Astryx power search field.

``config`` describes the searchable fields and their operators, and ``value``
holds the current filter records, each ``{"field": ..., "operator": ...,
"value": ...}``. Both are plain JSON, matching how :class:`Table` and
:class:`TreeList` take their data.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                            | Description                                                                                                                             | Default    |
|--------------|---------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| config       | Mapping\[str, Any\]             | Search configuration: ``{"name": ..., "fields": [...]}``, where each field takes a ``key``, a ``label``, and an ``operators`` sequence. | _required_ |
| filters      | Iterable\[Mapping\[str, Any\]\] | Active filter records, synchronized as ``value``.                                                                                       | `()`       |
| label        | str                             | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                          | `''`       |
| placeholder  | str \| None                     | Placeholder text shown when no filter is set.                                                                                           | `None`     |
| disabled     | bool                            | Whether the component should render disabled.                                                                                           | `False`    |
| read_only    | bool \| None                    | Whether existing filters can be edited.                                                                                                 | `None`     |
| clear        | bool \| None                    | Whether to show a clear control.                                                                                                        | `None`     |
| label_hidden | bool \| None                    | Whether to visually hide the accessible label.                                                                                          | `None`     |
| menu_width   | int \| None                     | Fixed suggestion menu width in pixels.                                                                                                  | `None`     |
| **props      | Any                             | JSON-safe PowerSearch props forwarded to Astryx.                                                                                        | `{}`       |
| See          |                                 |                                                                                                                                         | _required_ |
